results.title: Trophy
results.overview: The story follows So-hee, a 14-year-old Zainichi Korean girl. She goes to a Korean school and devotes herself to Korean traditional dance as her school club activities. One day, at an exchange event with a Japanese school, she befriends Mirai, a Japanese girl who shares her love of K-pop. Through this encounter, So-hee gradually begins to connect with the world beyond her own. As their friendship deepens, the two decide to sell unused items from So-hee's home on a flea market app to earn money for their favorite K-pop idols live tickets. One item fetches an unexpectedly high price-a North Korean CD, which is So-hee's father's. Sanju, the father, is the principal of a Korean elementary school. Emboldened by this success, So-hee and Mirai take it a step further, eventually selling even the medal that Sanju had been awarded by his homeland, North Korea.

results.title: The Hatred Spirit
results.original_title: អន្ទងខ្មោចតាយហោង

results.title: A Bit of Meaning
results.overview: Antoni lives by routine and isolation, hoping they will keep his depression and guilt at bay. His carefully controlled life is disrupted when he meets Olga, a volatile but determined warehouse worker whose reckless energy and dream of opening a bakery pull him into an unexpected relationship.

results.title: Romain Ntamack, tu seras un homme mon fils
results.original_title: Romain Ntamack, tu seras un homme mon fils
results.overview: The story of Romain Ntamack, French rugby star, who practically grew up in the locker rooms of the French national team and Stade Toulousain. Following in the footsteps of his father Émile, a global legend in the sport. For two years, Charlène Ravin and Benoit Pensivy's cameras followed Romain and his family. An exceptional immersion with the Ntamack family, featuring exclusive interviews with Thierry Dusautoir, Antoine Dupont, Jonny Wilkinson, and Dan Carter.

results.title: Remember
results.overview: A story that examines memory, personal identity, and the lasting impressions we leave behind.

results.title: Tears of The Meniscus
results.overview: At 40, Link is a depressed loser living on government welfare. He finds himself forced to become a responsible hero—entirely against his will—after accidentally letting Ganondorf kidnap the King of Hyrule. Under threat from Zelda, who promises to cut off his welfare checks if he doesn't rescue her father, Link embarks on an epic… and completely absurd quest.

results.title: Filmy Looking Glass
results.overview: As a woman wearing a mask on a meadow and a man in his living room gaze deeply into each other’s eyes via his television, the boundary between fiction and reality shifts. A dialogue-free and interpretively open art project about the influence of film on humans and vice versa, which raises the question of whether we, as viewers, might at precisely this moment merge with the play on the screen.

results.title: AI AI AI - Eine Synchron Dystopie
results.original_title: AI AI AI - Eine Synchron Dystopie

results.title: How To Not Have Sex
results.overview: Three high school friends reunite after 10 years and confront a case of sexual misconduct that none of them were ready for. As layers of denial resurface, the film traces the thin lines that lie between sex, persuasion, and consent.

results.title: Zoners
results.overview: Brothers, flatmates and polar opposites Samir and Nikhil find themselves on an adventure when they accidentally steal a package from their maniac neighbour Ivan.

results.title: Thou Shall Not Commit Adultery
results.overview: When Cassie, a Christian feminist icon and bestselling author, is blackmailed with videos of her affair, she must fight to protect her brand and marriage. But as her trusted assistant's betrayal escalates, Cassie faces a terrifying choice.

results.title: Gauthali
results.overview: Child bride Gauthali overcomes abuse, loss, and discrimination through the power of education. Her determination to reclaim her future challenges deep-rooted traditions inspiring to stand against gender inequality.

results.title: Chatha Pacha: The Ring of Rowdies
results.original_title: ചത്താ പച്ച: The Ring of Rowdies
results.overview: In the heart of Fort Kochi, three brothers and their crew of unlikely misfits stumble into the wild world of WWE-style costumed wrestling. What begins as a scrappy hustle soon explodes into a riot of masks, egos, and full-blown madness, all set against the backdrop of a city that never plays by the rules. But can their brotherhood survive when the real fight begins outside the ropes?

results.title: Dances with Weights
results.overview: After a misunderstanding, a famous strength athletics trainer accidentally finds himself at the position of training an elite dance squad, creating a conflict of interests which only increases after his protege Sashko falls in love with Milana, one of the the dance squad's most talented members. Will the two sides use their strengths to work together or will this match made in Hell crash and burn?

results.title: Loja e Fundit
results.overview: Luizi, a forgotten singer, suddenly becomes famous overnight and all of Albania goes crazy. In order to protect his fame and win the heart of Kiara, the girl he loves, he must keep a lie alive, one that drags them both into a chain of hilarious and chaotic situations.

results.title: Dans le ventre du léviathan
results.overview: In the infirmary of a strange underwater trawler, a human surgeon treats a crew entirely composed of android slaves.

results.title: Dhood (Sandstorm)
results.overview: Set against the vast expanse of the Thar desert, an isolated family's desperate wishes and psychological friction trigger a dark domestic countdown, threatening to reduce their household entirely into dust

results.title: Requiem For a Play
results.overview: Lev, a brilliant but hot-headed playwright, finds himself exiled from New York's Broadway scene after a series of costly failures and tumultuous relationships with cast and crew. Seeking redemption, he relocates to a small, struggling theatre in Toronto, where he must stage his most ambitious work yet. Surrounded by a ragtag team of aspiring actors, overworked technicians, and Alec, an unyielding young stage manager, Lev grapples with his own demons and the pressure to succeed. As tensions rise during rehearsals, personal conflicts threaten to unravel the production, forcing Lev to confront the ghosts of his past and find a way to lead his team to opening night. A raw and intimate exploration of artistry, ego, and second chances, Requiem's Veil shines a spotlight on the human spirit's ability to persevere under the weight of failure and ambition.
